(Currently Amended) A system for generating a counter-stimulation in a patient suffering from RLS, the system comprising: a device configured and arranged to generate a counter-stimulation in a patient suffering from RLS, the counter-stimulation of an amplitude, intensity, and time duration __sufficient to relieve RLS symptoms and allow the patient to return to sleep without waking the patient__; a controller configured and arranged to drive the counter-stimulation generation device, the controller in communication with the counter-stimulation device; and a base configured and arranged to hold the counter-stimulation generation device adjacent to a patient, the counter-stimulation device attached to the base.

(Currently Amended) The system according to Claim 2, wherein the device comprises a stimulator selected from the group consisting of a fluid pressure applicator, a mechanical point pressure applicator, a mechanical roller, a mechanical lift, a vibration generator, a nerve stimulator, a muscle stimulator, a heater, a cooler, a chemical applicator, and a magnet, wherein __at least one of the stimulators provides vibrational therapy__.

(Currently Amended) A method of treating RLS, the method comprising: selecting a patient experiencing RLS; stimulating a portion of the patient at an amplitude, intensity, and duration __sufficient to generate a counter-stimulation to RLS symptoms while allowing the patient to return to sleep or to not wake a sleeping patient__.
